title: Swanky & Stylish Old Town Scottsdale Luxe Retreat
description:
Experience the vibrancy of Scottsdale in unmatched style at this newly remodeled, swanky vacation home located in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale. Just a leisurely stroll (2 minute walk) from the upscale Scottsdale Fashion Square, Ocean 44, and Toca Modera and less than 1.2 miles from the entertainment hubs of Old Town, this prime location ensures you're always just moments away from the best dining, shopping, and nightlife that Scottsdale has to offer.

 The space 
Convenient golf cart rides and Uber services are readily available to whisk you to your desired destinations within the Old Town area.

Spacious and Modern Living: The home boasts five tastefully decorated bedrooms and four modern bathrooms, offering comfort and luxury for up to ten guests.

Entertainment Haven: Dive into entertainment with a cinema-style theatre room perfect for movie nights, a game room filled with bar-style games for endless fun, and a dedicated workout area for fitness enthusiasts.

Outdoor Paradise: Step outside to a large, heated swimming pool and a hot tub, where you can relax and soak up the Arizona sun with a breathtaking view of the iconic Camelback Mountain. The outdoor area is also equipped with a BBQ and ample seating, ideal for enjoying private dinners and social gatherings.

- - - - -

Pool Heating*

‍There is an additional fee of $150 per night to heat up the swimming pool with a three night minimum. This is paid after the reservation is made.

- - - - -

Before booking this home, please review ALL house rules to make sure that this is the right home for you. Feel free to reach out with any questions.

VacayAZ enforces good neighbor policies on all managed properties. Renting homes in a neighborhood/community is a privilege and must be treated as such. Guests must be mindful of their noise levels at all times and respect the rules of the community. We do not provide speakers and/or sound systems on-site.

There is no garage access as it has been converted into the game room. There is room for parking in the driveway. 

Anyone found to be violating noise ordinances will be subject to an immediate $500 fine, in addition to City-imposed fines which can reach up to $10,000 per violation and can be removed from the property due to negligence. Per city requirements, maximum family size is restricted to 6 adults and their related dependent children, up to 16 guests total.

Smoking is not allowed in this property. Violating this policy will result in forfeiture of the full security deposit and guests will be liable for the full cost of damage resulting from it.
